podcast.title: First Vaporwave Recordings (2009)
podcast.body: In 2009, Daniel Lopatin, then known by his YouTube handle SunsetCorp and later also as Oneohtrix Point Never, uploaded the earliest recordings of what would become vaporwave to his channel. These videos featured extracts of popular songs, slowed down, pitch-shifted, and looped, accompanied by unsettling and nostalgic images related to technology. "Las primeras grabaciones del género las podemos escuchar en el año 2009, cuando los veros de YouTube, San SetCorp, quien más tarde se descubrió que se trataba de Daniel Dopatín, más conocido por su proyecto, One-Etricks, Ponnevar, subió los vídeos en su canal."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Pivotal Figure in Vaporwave's Origins
podcast.body: Daniel Lopatin is considered, alongside James Ferraro and Vektroid, one of the most important individuals in the development of vaporwave, having been responsible for some of its foundational musical experiments and releases. "Sin duda, junto a Ferraro y Lopatín, la persona más importante dentro del vaporwave."
